case.summary: The customer holds payment of invoice 90001873: wrong price, and part of the delivery is not invoiced.

lines: Our goods receipt on 14 Oct and 16 Oct shows 200 pcs of HP-4400.
Your invoice bills 160 pcs at 125.00 EUR. Our rate contract RA-4410 says 118.75 EUR.
Please correct the price and bill the rest. Payment of the open invoice is on hold until then.
Subject: Delivery 80004711 item 20 - packaging inspection closed
The 40 pcs from the second goods issue (16 Oct) had damaged outer packaging.
Inspection finished on 22 Oct: goods are fine, nothing to return.
Billing block 01 is still set on item 20. Please release it.
Entered with the standard price list because the order was not linked to a contract.
Standard price HP-4400 is 125.00 EUR per piece.
Rate contract RA-4410 with Bergmann Handel GmbH
3.1 Price HP-4400: 118.75 EUR per piece, net
5.2 Contract prices apply to all orders placed during the term.

findings.text: 200 pcs were delivered in two goods issues: 160 pcs on 14 Oct and 40 pcs on 16 Oct.
Invoice 90001873 bills 160 pcs. The 40 pcs of delivery item 20 are not invoiced.
Delivery item 20 carries billing block 01. Logistics asked on 22 Oct to release it; nobody did.
The contract price is 118.75 EUR per piece. The invoice used 125.00 EUR.
The order was placed inside the contract term, so the contract price applies to it.
Cause: the order was entered with the standard price list and not linked to the contract.

proposals.label: Changes something
proposals.done: Billing block 01 removed on delivery 80004711, item 20 (sample).

proposals.done: Credit memo request 60000318 created for invoice 90001873 (sample).

questions.q: Why does the customer say the invoice is wrong?

calls.result: 1 order, 1 delivery (2 items), 1 billing document (1 item)

answer: Two things are wrong. The invoice used the standard price of 125.00 EUR instead of the contract price of 118.75 EUR (proof: C1 line 3, invoice item 10).
It also bills 160 of 200 pieces: item 20 (40 pcs) has billing block 01 since 16 Oct (proof: E2 line 4).

questions.q: What is the net effect once both are corrected?
answer: Credit for the price difference: 1,000.00 EUR (160 pcs x 6.25 EUR). Additional invoice for item 20: 4,750.00 EUR (40 pcs x 118.75 EUR).
Net, the customer owes 3,750.00 EUR more. The corrected total for 200 pcs is 23,750.00 EUR.

questions.q: Can Lena release the credit memo request herself?

calls.result: limit 500.00 EUR, request 1,000.00 EUR: not allowed

answer: No. Her limit for credit memo requests is 500.00 EUR and this one is 1,000.00 EUR. The team lead (limit 5,000.00 EUR) has to release it.
Claude and the Joule agent cannot release anything. A person decides.
